briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Bleed the Crow-Crowned Boss Mound: Boss Chamber. Enter Crow-Crowned Boss Mound on Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate while the Gate remains Sealed Gate with fae time bleed. Reference deity voice is Brigid, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the boss encounter against The Crow-Crowned Geas Breaker inside the elite-tuned Crow-Crowned Boss Mound and complete the Ascension route without breaking canon.

missionIntro.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A geas is a road that remembers the foot that broke it. The Crow-Crowned Boss Mound will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the boss pressure of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: silver-root snares that remember previous steps

victory.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
victory.text: The root remembers obedience and opens one more ring.

defeat.speaker: Brigid Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Silver-Root Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Avalora is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Crow-Crowned Boss Mound as part of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth.

soloTitanPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Crow-Crowned Boss Mound as a boss node in Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth; silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable Titan language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Titan language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
